This '''national electoral calendar for 2027''' lists the national and federal elections scheduled to be held in 2027 in all [[List of sovereign states|sovereign states]] and their [[Dependent territory|dependent territories]]. [[By-election]]s are excluded, though national [[referendum]]s are included. Specific dates are given when known.
{{Elections}}

==January==
* 16 January: [[Elections in Nigeria|Nigeria]], [[2027 Nigerian general election|President, Senate and House of Representatives]]
* 27 January: [[Elections in Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyzstan]], [[2027 Kyrgyz presidential election|President]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Chipegin |first=Anton |date=2025-04-16 |title=Kyrgyzstan Sets Date for 2027 Presidential Election - The Times Of Central Asia |url=https://timesca.com/kyrgyzstan-sets-date-for-2027-presidential-election/ |access-date=2026-03-27 |language=en-US}}</ref>

==February==
* 28 February: [[Elections in El Salvador|El Salvador]], [[2027 Salvadoran presidential election|President]] and [[2027 Salvadoran legislative election|Legislative Assembly]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://lanoticiasv.com/el-tse-reafirma-que-las-elecciones-de-2027-se-realizaran-el-28-de-febrero/|title=Las elecciones de 2027 se realizarán el 28 de febrero |language=es|date=6 October 2025 |work=La Noticia SV|first1=David|last1=Morales}}</ref>

==March==
* March: [[Estonia]], [[Next Estonian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
* 2 March: [[Elections in Micronesia|Micronesia]], [[2027 Micronesian general election|Parliament]]
* March: ''[[Elections in Somaliland|Somaliland]], [[2027 Somaliland parliamentary election|Parliament]]''

==April==
* 10 April: [[Elections in the Gambia|Gambia]], [[2027 Gambian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=cfeditoren |date=2025-10-13 |title=IEC Announces 2026-2027 Election Dates |url=https://www.africa-press.net/gambia/all-news/iec-announces-2026-2027-election-dates |access-date=2026-04-14 |website=Gambia |language=en-US}}</ref>
* 18 April: 
** [[Elections in France|France]], [[2027 French presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Quelles sont les dates des prochaines élections ? |url=https://www.service-public.gouv.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F34852/5_0?lang=en |website=Service Public |publisher=Government of France |language=fr |date=27 August 2025}}</ref>
** [[Elections in Finland|Finland]], [[2027 Finnish parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://vaalit.fi/en/schedule-in-the-parliamentary-elections|title=Schedule for the 2027 parliamentary elections|publisher=Vaalit.fi|access-date=17 January 2026}}</ref>
* April: [[Elections in Andorra|Andorra]], [[2027 Andorran parliamentary election|Parliament]]
